397502.title: Paradise in Progress
397502.overview: A contemporary exhibition at Gangneung's municipal art museum, a short walk from the city centre and easy to combine with a day on the east coast. Free.

397952.title: Geometric Symbiosis: Connection
397952.overview: Seo Hyun-gyu builds what he calls artificial ecosystems out of cold industrial materials — bolts, nuts and stainless steel mirrors — repeating mechanical joints until the metal takes the form of a living tree. Connection is both the structural principle and the metaphor: frameworks of fasteners and wire stand in for how modern relationships hold together through mutual dependence, while mirrored surfaces keep reflecting the viewer back into the work. Free, in Gwacheon just south of Seoul.

397545.title: A Story Filled with Blanks
397545.venue: Cheongju Art Studio, Cheongju Municipal Library
397545.overview: Part of a relay of exhibitions by artists in residence at the Cheongju Art Studio, one of Korea's longer-running municipal residency programmes. Free.

397546.title: Storehouse of Forgetting
397546.venue: Cheongju Art Studio, Cheongju Municipal Library
397546.overview: The second half of the Cheongju Art Studio relay project, showing new work by the studio's resident artists. Free.

394684.title: ACC Pansori Series IV — Jeokbyeok: The Red River
394684.overview: Pansori is sung storytelling for one voice and one drum, and Jeokbyeokga — the Battle of Red Cliffs — is the most demanding of the five surviving pieces, built around a Chinese war epic and famous for the passage where the dead soldiers sing. This showcase is the fourth in the Asia Culture Center's series reworking the repertoire for a contemporary stage. Free admission, in a building that is itself worth the visit: the ACC is built largely underground beneath the site of the 1980 Gwangju Uprising.

397503.title: Images of the Everyday: How Do They Speak to Us?
397503.venue: Seoul National University Museum of Art
397503.overview: An exhibition at SNU's art museum, a concrete cantilevered building designed by Rem Koolhaas on the university's mountainside campus in southern Seoul. Free.

395051.title: Ullim Contemporary Gugak Group: Four Seasons
395051.venue: Oyou Art Hall, Dogok 2 Culture Center
395051.overview: A small-hall concert by Ullim, an ensemble that writes new music for traditional Korean instruments rather than performing the inherited repertoire. At 10,000 won in a neighbourhood culture centre in Gangnam, it is about as low-cost as live gugak gets in Seoul.

395671.title: Saturday Gugak at Namdo: Chuseok Special — The Great Market
395671.venue: Jinakdang Hall, National Namdo Gugak Center
395671.overview: The Chuseok edition of the weekly Saturday programme at the national gugak centre on Jindo — the island that gave Korea Jindo Arirang, ssitgimgut shamanic rites and the ganggangsullae circle dance, and which holds more intangible heritage designations per head than anywhere else in the country. Staged as a village market. Free.

395873.title: Chuseok Concert 2026: The Full Bright Moon
395873.overview: Chuseok falls on the fifteenth day of the eighth lunar month, when the moon is full, and the National Gugak Center marks it with an outdoor performance in its open-air yeonhui yard — the venue used for the loud, mobile forms: farmers' percussion, mask dance, tightrope. 10,000 won.
